teszt_metaadatok.tema: microbiology ch. 6, 6.2 The Viral Life Cycle

kerdesek.kerdes: What is the name for the transfer of genetic information from one bacterium to another bacterium by a phage?
evidence: Transduction occurs when a bacteriophage transfers bacterial DNA from one bacterium to another during sequential infections.

kerdesek.kerdes: What is a characteristic of a positive-strand RNA virus?
kerdesek.helyes_valasz: can be used directly to translate viral proteins.
disztraktorok: must first be converted to a mRNA before it can be translated.
will be degraded by host enzymes.
is not recognized by host ribosomes.
evidence: If the viral genome is RNA, a different mechanism must be used.
If a virus has a + ssRNA genome, it can be translated directly to make viral proteins.

kerdesek.kerdes: Which of the following components is brought into a cell by HIV?
evidence: Single-stranded RNA viruses such as HIV carry a special enzyme called reverse transcriptase within the capsid that synthesizes a complementary ssDNA (cDNA) copy using the + ssRNA genome as a template.

kerdesek.kerdes: Which of the following leads to the destruction of the host cells?
evidence: During the lytic cycle of viral replication, the virus hijacks the host cell, degrades the host chromosome, and makes more viral genomes.
